title: F41: a clean fleet rebase always re-runs Build + Audit for an explanation-doc cycle — the RUNG 0 carry-forward is unreachable, and the long rebuild window loses the race to the next peer ship
summary: When a fleet lane's ship finds main moved by a peer (GIT_FLEET_REBASE_NEEDED), core/ship_recovery.go recoverFromShipError rebases the cycle branch and — for any cycle with explanation documentation (ExplanationDocumentationVersion > 0, i.e. every build since #518) — returns PhaseBuild immediately after explanationdocs.RebaseBuildAndPersist invalidates the approved snapshot. That early return sits BEFORE the carry-forward ladder: RUNG 0 (compositionCarryForward, cycle-801: the composed diff's patch-id still matches what the audit reviewed and every composed-tree gate is green ⇒ composition-verdict + reship) and RUNG 2 (scopedMergeCarryForward, cycle-941). So a clean, disjoint rebase costs an LLM rebuild plus a full re-audit (~30+ min) even when the lane's patch-id is unchanged. Evidence: cycle 1637 (knowledge-base/cycles/cycle-1637.json) went audit PASS → ship FAIL (rebase needed) → build → audit PASS → ship FAIL → build → audit WARN → ship FAIL ×3 more → retro FAIL: five rebuild/re-audit rounds, each long enough for a peer to ship again, sealed FAIL on correct work. Cycle 1691 (wave 8) hit the same path at 06:31 after 1690 shipped (clean rebase: 1690 touched statemap/reset/failurelog, 1691 phases/ship/consume.go) and paid a rebuild + re-audit; it survives only because no peer is in flight. As lanes start shipping together this becomes the dominant cost of every non-first lane in a wave.
root_cause: Feature interaction: #518 bound the explanation document to the pre-rebase base SHA and chose Builder re-authoring ('only Builder-authored documentation can bind and explain the rebased diff') for EVERY rebase, including one where the lane's patch-id is unchanged — the case in which the approved, Builder-authored document already explains byte-identical hunks.
fix: After a clean rebase, try the carry-forward ladder BEFORE invalidating the explanation: when the lane's patch-id is unchanged (RUNG 0's own precondition) and the explanation snapshot's documented diff matches the rebased diff, carry the approved Builder-authored explanation forward by rebinding it to the new base (a deterministic rebind of an unchanged document — the host authors nothing), then run compositionCarryForward (composed-tree gates) → reship. Only when a rung rejects fall back to RebaseBuildAndPersist → Build. Design points for review: what the snapshot pins (base SHA, diff hash, document sha256) and which of those a rebind may update; crash-safety of the rebind (the existing write-ahead activation marker idiom); the ship-recovery budget.
acceptance: RED first: a fleet lane whose clean rebase leaves its patch-id unchanged reships via the composition carry-forward with NO Build or Audit re-dispatch, its explanation binding re-bound to the new base (the cycle-1691 shape, pinned end to end through recoverFromShipError)
A rebase that changes the lane's patch-id (overlapping edits) still invalidates the explanation and returns to Build (existing RebaseBuildAndPersist path)
The rebind never changes the document's bytes or sha256 and is refused when the documented diff does not match the rebased diff
A replay of cycle 1637's sequence (audit PASS then repeated peer moves) ships on the first recovery instead of chasing to FAIL
ADR note (explanation documentation × ADR-0049 S5b) + incident record (cycles 1637/1691) + REGRESSION-COVERAGE-INDEX row
